plain: Suffered or gone through, as a loss or injury; also held up or supported

webster.text: Borne; upheld; maintained; supported; subsisted; suffered.

example.quote: As to the reimbursement of the loss that may be sustained by individuals, a tax may be laid on tobacco, when brought to the warehouses, for that purpose.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 17, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
